docset:CreditAgreementName.docset:CreditCommitment: BETWEEN: Thalassa Sub-Ice Leisure Corp., a corporation organized under the laws of the Jovian Maritime Authority (the "Borrower"), and United Jovian Credit Corp., a financial institution organized under the Lunar-Jovian Banking Accord (the "Lender").

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.5em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslateblue

docset:CreditFacilityTerms.dg:chunk: ARTICLE I: THE FACILITY & KEY TERMS

docset:CreditCommitment.docset:CreditCommitment: Subject to the terms and conditions herein, Lender agrees to extend a term loan facility to Borrower in the principal amount of 750,000,000 Europa Credit Units (ECU) (the "Loan"). The Loan shall be disbursed to fund capital improvements at the Thalassa Hydrothermal Rift Resort, specifically the expansion of the primary pressure dome and installation of upgraded geothermal siphons.

dg:InterestRateStructure.dg:chunk: The outstanding principal balance shall bear interest at a floating rate equal to the Ganymede Interbank Offered Rate (GIBOR) plus 3.50% per annum. Interest shall be computed on the basis of a 360-day Jovian standard orbital year and actual days elapsed.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.5em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslateblue

docset:OperationalRiskCovenants.dg:chunk: ARTICLE II: SPECIALIZED OPERATIONAL & FINANCIAL COVENANTS

dg:StructuralIntegrityCovenant.dg:chunk: Borrower covenants to maintain structural hull integrity at a minimum of 120 Mega-Pascals (MPa) as verified by automated quantum acoustic monitoring. Weekly telemetry logs must be archived and delivered to Lender. Any deviation below 120 MPa for twelve (12) consecutive hours constitutes an immediate material Event of Default.

dg:DebtServiceReserve.dg:chunk: Section 2.02 Restricted Payments and Debt Service Reserve Account (DSRA)
dg:DebtServiceReserve.dg:DebtServiceReserve: Borrower shall establish and maintain a DSRA with Lender. At all times, the DSRA shall be funded with cash or high-liquidity offworld cash equivalents in an amount equal to two (2) succeeding quarters of principal and interest payments. No distributions, dividends, or affiliate payments may be made if the DSRA balance falls below the required threshold or if the Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) falls below 1.45x.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.5em; text-transform: uppercase; color: darkslateblue

dg:FinancialReportingCovenants.dg:chunk: ARTICLE III: FINANCIAL REPORTING & DEFAULT REMEDIES

docset:SeismicRiskCovenant.dg:chunk: Section 3.01 Financial Covenant Adjustments for Lunar Alignment

The parties acknowledge that tidal flexing induced by the orbital resonance of Io, Europa, and Ganymede increases seismic stress on geothermal interfaces. In quarters where tidal flexing forces exceed normal baseline averages by 15%, the required Minimum DSCR covenant shall adjust from 1.45x to 1.35x, provided that cash reserves in the CapEx Account are increased by 5,000,000 ECU.

dg:EventOfDefaultRemedies.dg:EventOfDefaultRemedies: Upon the occurrence of an Event of Default (including pressure breaches, biological containment failure, or DSCR breach), Lender may accelerate all outstanding amounts, foreclose on the collateralized sub-ice lease rights, and assume operational control of the life-support grid.
